entries.description: Free browser-based tool to intentionally degrade images: deep fry memes, compress to a target file size, pixelate, add CRT/vintage effects. 100% client-side, no uploads.
representativeQueries: free online tool to make an image low quality
deep fry a meme in the browser
compress an image to a target file size like 20KB
add pixelation and CRT retro effects to a photo
